unit: pooled same-receiver same-cycle Target-minus-Reference differences; publication caption ambiguity explicitly retained
histogram_source: right-hand Joint-Spot histogram recipe, retaining all counts
last_region: Combine the final two equal-height source bins because their internal boundary is not visible
normalization: count / (total native sample count * region width in dB)
height_allowance: Source-only +/-0.0005 per dB; no fitted or sampling allowance
rounding: Use source nearest-decimal intervals for displayed mean and sample standard deviation; not confidence intervals
inferred_count: Diagnostic only; exact166 asserted only as independently derived archive baseline
geography: Descriptive audit only; no geographic paper oracle
source_selection: Installed demo fixed without searching or adjusting its window/callsigns/range to fit extracted bars
